Price +2 bonus; Aura moderate necromancy; CL 10th; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This magic weapon property acts like the soul trapping magical weapon property except that it activates if it kills a qualifying creature, even with normal hits.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost: +2 bonus Craft Magic Arms and Armor, soul trap
